title: Choose early or late order
hints: Locate each element in its family.
Compare only the two bonding 2p levels.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: In the early sequence π₂p lies below σ₂p; the oxygen family reverses their order.
statement:
Which ordering comparison is correct for $\ce{N2}$ and $\ce{O2}$?

[_]{a}

choices: π₂p lies below σ₂p in N₂, and above it in O₂.
π₂p lies above σ₂p in both.
π₂p lies below σ₂p in both.
The two orbitals are degenerate in both.
explanations: The π pair is internally degenerate, not with σ.
